historical_record.description: The Western Furniture Exchange, built 1937 and altered in 1950; rated Category I under Article 11 of the Planning Code.

The San Francisco Merchandise Mart, eleven storeys on Market Street between Ninth and Tenth, is a Category I building under Article 11 of the Planning Code — at least forty years old, individually important, and rated excellent in architectural design.
